profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Building Scalable Apps with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer focused on building scalable, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS.

I specialize in taking products from idea to production, designing intuitive user interfaces, building robust backend systems, and delivering full-stack solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and built to scale.
My experience includes developing responsive frontends, designing and integrating APIs, and optimizing performance across the stack. I’m passionate about solving real-world problems through code and continuously improving my skills in modern web development and cloud architecture.

Core skills:
• Full Stack Development
• React / Next.js
• Node.js & API Development
• TypeScript
• AWS & Cloud Services

I’m currently open to Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer opportunities where I can contribute to impactful products, collaborate with strong teams, and continue growing as an engineer.

Feel free to connect or reach out if you're hiring or building something interesting.
